words: avoid
/əˈvɔɪd/ verb. 避开，避免（常接动词-ing形式，表示避开做某事或避开某人）
pretend
/prɪˈtend/ verb. 假装，装作（常接that从句或to be结构）
insist
/ɪnˈsɪst/ verb. 坚持，坚决要求（insist on doing something坚持做某事）
prevent
/prɪˈvent/ verb. 阻止，阻挡（prevent sb. from doing sth.阻止某人做某事）
fancy
/ˈfænsi/ verb. 想不到，竟然（Fancy meeting you here!想不到在这儿遇见你！）
wonder
/ˈwʌndə(r)/ verb. 想知道，琢磨（wonder how/why/whether想知道如何/为什么/是否）
dentist
/ˈdentɪst/ noun. 牙医（go to the dentist's去看牙医）
plenty
/ˈplenti/ pronoun. 大量，充足（plenty of + 名词，意为“大量的”）
wait
/weɪt/ verb. 等待，等候（wait for sb./sth.等待某人/某物）
lie
/laɪ/ verb. 说谎，撒谎（lie to sb.对某人说谎，过去式为lied）
follow
/ˈfɒləʊ/ verb. 跟随，跟着（follow sb. around跟着某人）
busy
/ˈbɪzi/ adjective. 忙碌的，繁忙的（be busy doing sth.忙于做某事）
finish
/ˈfɪnɪʃ/ verb. 完成，结束（finish doing sth.完成做某事）
wave
/weɪv/ verb. 挥手，招手（wave to sb.向某人挥手）
cross
/krɒs/ verb. 穿过，越过（cross the street穿过街道）
phrases: avoid doing something
避免做某事
I crossed the street to avoid meeting him.
我穿过街道以避免遇见他。
You should avoid making the same mistake.
你应该避免犯同样的错误。
come running towards
跑向，朝...跑来
He saw me and came running towards me.
他看见了我然后朝我跑过来。
no matter how
无论怎样，不管如何
No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
无论你有多忙，他总是坚持要陪着你。
No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't open the door.
无论我多努力，我都打不开门。
think of a way of doing something
想个办法做某事
I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me.
我得想个办法阻止他跟着我。
prevent someone from doing something
阻止某人做某事
I tried to prevent him from following me around.
我试图阻止他一直跟着我。
Fancy meeting you here!
想不到在这儿遇见你！（表示惊讶）
Fancy meeting you here! I thought you were in London.
想不到在这儿遇见你！我以为你在伦敦呢。
Would you mind my coming with you?
你介意我和你一起去吗？（表示委婉请求）
Would you mind my coming with you to the shops?
你介意我和你一起去商店吗？
There's plenty to read
有很多可读的（有很多阅读材料）
There's always plenty to read in the waiting room.
候诊室里总有很多东西可读。
There's plenty to see in this city.
这座城市有很多可看的东西。
have anything to do
有什么事要做
He never has anything to do.
他从来都没什么事可做。
before I had finished speaking
在我说完之前
He asked, before I had finished speaking.
他在我说完之前就问道。

grammar.d: 某些动词后面需要接动名词（verb + -ing）作宾语，表示习惯性或一般性的动作 常与enjoy, avoid, finish, insist on, prevent...from, mind等动词连用
ex: I never enjoy meeting Nigel Dykes.
我从来不喜欢遇到奈杰尔·戴克斯。
He always insists on coming with you.
prevent him from following me around

grammar.k: Would you mind + 物主代词/名词所有格 + doing?
grammar.f: Would you mind my/nickname's + 动词-ing?
grammar.d: 用来委婉地询问或请求许可，询问对方是否介意自己做某事 回答时常用Not at all（不介意）或I'm sorry, but...（介意）
ex: Would you mind my coming with you?
你介意我和你一起去吗？
Would you mind my opening the window?

grammar.k: No matter how + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语
grammar.f: No matter how + adj./adv. + 主语 + 谓语
grammar.d: 无论多么...，不管怎样...，用来引导让步状语从句 相当于However，用于强调无论条件如何变化，结果或情况不变
ex: No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
无论你有多忙，他总是坚持要陪着你。
No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't convince him.
无论我多努力，我都说服不了他。

patterns.p: I had to think of a way of + 动名词
o: I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me around all morning.
我得想个办法阻止他一整个上午都跟着我。
im: I had to think of a way of getting rid of him.
She had to think of a way of explaining her absence.
她得想个办法解释她的缺席。

patterns.p: No matter how + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + be动词/情态动词
o: No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
无论你有多忙，他总是坚持要陪着你。
im: No matter how tired I am, I must finish my work.
无论我有多累，我必须完成工作。
No matter how cold it is, she goes running every morning.
无论天气多冷，她每天早上都去跑步。

patterns.p: Would you mind my + 动名词?
o: Would you mind my coming with you?
你介意我和你一起去吗？
im: Would you mind my sitting here?
Would you mind my using your phone?
你介意我用一下你的电话吗？

patterns.p: There's plenty to + 动词原形
o: There's always plenty to read in the waiting room!
候诊室里总有很多东西可读！
im: There's plenty to see in this museum.
这个博物馆有很多可看的。
There's plenty to do in London during the holiday.
假期里伦敦有很多可做的活动。
